title: RFC005 §30.6 S2 Exposure Policy
$comment: Closed envelope for the five §30.6 caps a run policy 'musí pinovať': maximum views per lineage per virtual epoch, maximum fragment overlap exposure, maximum augmentation variants, P5 repeat cap, and the synthetic recipe/family cap. A SEPARATE policy artefact from s2_sampler_policy on purpose (§45 lists sampler-policy.json and exposure-policy.json as distinct files): the sampler policy pins HOW a lineage is weighted, the exposure policy pins HOW OFTEN any lineage may be seen. Mixing them would let a weight change silently re-price exposure, which is exactly the drift this split exists to prevent.

stage_id.$comment: The S2 policy shape, reused by S3 (as S2) and by S4 with its own budget (owner 2026-09-21: 15 000 draws, 2 views); any other stage is a schema error rather than a silent cross-wire.

max_views_per_lineage_per_virtual_epoch.$comment: §30.6 cap 1. The sampler refuses to build a plan whose pool cannot satisfy the epoch under this cap rather than silently over-exposing a lineage.

max_fragment_overlap_exposure.$comment: §30.6 cap 2: the maximum number of times one fragment's content may be re-exposed through overlapping fragments within the run. 0 forbids any overlap.

max_augmentation_variants.$comment: §30.6 cap 3: at most this many augmentation variants of one source may enter the run.

p5_repeat_cap.$comment: §30.6 cap 4: the maximum number of times a P5 full-document lineage may repeat in the run. 0 forbids P5 repeats entirely; §30.7 forbids the dataloader from topping a shortfall up with P2/P4.

synthetic_recipe_family_cap.$comment: §30.6 cap 5: the maximum number of documents from one synthetic recipe/family in the run — 'žiadna jedna lineage alebo template family nesmie dominovať' (§30.4).
